text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty P-19281 fired for service="inference-runtime-prod" — symptom: p99 latency 1400ms (threshold 800ms). Alert tag: latency-slo-burn. Grafana: https://grafana.company/r/abcd
pagerduty: PagerDuty: page sent to oncall-jun (primary).
oncall-jun: acked P-19281 — I'm taking this. Triage now, will post updates.
maya: seeing spike in eu-west and us-east, distribution looks multi-region. p99 ~1400ms, p95 ~420ms. Dashboard link above.
eli: any increase in 5xx?
maya: 5xx flat, timeouts slightly up. CPU/GPU not saturated but queue depth up on sidecars. My hypothesis: KV cache miss storm -> higher tail.
oncall-jun: good call. Quick mitigation: increase inference pool + route non-critical traffic to smaller quantized model. Applying now.
oncall-jun: ```
# quick mitigation commands
kubectl scale deployment/inference-pool-east --replicas=8 -n prod
/opt/ops/route-switch --service inference-runtime --fallback-model redwood-quant-1 --percent=30
```
infra-bot: Scaling started: inference-pool-east 5 -> 8 replicas (ETA ~45s). Rolling update in progress.
incident-bot: PagerDuty update: P-19281 acknowledged by oncall-jun.
maya: initiating 30% traffic shift to dedicated pool to reduce tail.
eli: logs show repeated kvcache evict loops around 03:12 UTC — likely hotkey churn. Sample log: `2026-03-17T03:12:05Z kvcache: evict key=conversation_42 size=2MB reason=hotkey`
oncall-jun: scale finished. observed p99 -> 900ms now (was 1400ms). p95 steady. Monitoring.
maya: :thumbsup: I'll open follow-up to tune eviction thresholds and investigate hotkey source. Assigning to @eli.
oncall-jun: plan: monitor for 10m. If p99 > 1000ms after 10m, escalate to @sre-lead and consider rollback of last runtime model. Keeping incident open for now.
sre-lead: standing by. ping me if metrics don't improve or error rate climbs.
support-notify: Notified support channel with current impact: latency-only, no error spike. Prep customer comms if we need to escalate. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
oncall-jun: marking customer impact = latency-only (sev-2). Will update once steady for 15m.
